vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." Better close to the fire today.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.

🛡️ A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm catches you eyeing the bark plates — claw-scored, vine-laced. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They talk you through it — wide strips dried flat, laced overlapping like shingles, snug but not tight. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
🍲 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm eats with A woman, maybe 30s, with tattooed arms — bowls side by side, talk low.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Correlation isn't cause, but three data points is a pattern. Noted."
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling A woman, maybe 50s about A person, maybe 50s, with deep-set eyes. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +3 clean.
🗣️ A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm to a man, maybe 30s, by the fire: "Stone. We need 59 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Hmm. That doesn't add up. Let me think it through out loud."
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling Priya about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about A person, maybe 50s, with deep-set eyes. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a slouched posture about A person, maybe 50s, with a shaved head. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
✅ You saw the creek. A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇯🇵 Japanese. You share no language at all.
🛡️ Linh, Reagan, Linda and Naran met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Reagan, Linda, Naran are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Linh just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

regDeaths.name: a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you
